verdict.rationale: cubic documents several ways to drive it in natural language. You can tag @cubic-dev-ai in PR comments to ask questions, trigger reviews and request fixes, and replying to its comments teaches it future behavior. Through its MCP server, a coding agent can request reviews, triage issues, and even manage subscription seats and roles from the MCP client. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the natural-language command flows, and evidence that configuration and admin beyond seats can be done conversationally (the AI chat sidebar sits under archived docs, and core config lives in cubic.yaml).
